## Speaker
Yiyi Wan

### Theme
An Invitation to Topological Orders and Category Theory (5)

### Abstract
Following our previous study of 1d domain walls, we continue by studying gapped 0d domain walls between 1d topological orders. We then introduce the notion of condensation completion. Finally, we explain how all gapped domain walls can be organized within fusion 2-categories.
